description: This PHP class 'JobTitleDao' provides data access methods for managing 'JobTitle' entities within the OrangeHRM system. It includes functions for retrieving lists of job titles, filtering by activity status, associating with employees, handling pagination, counting, deleting, and saving job titles, as well as managing related job specification attachments.

classes.name: JobTitleDao
classes.description: Data access object for managing JobTitle entities, including CRUD operations, filtering, and related attachments.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of job titles, optionally filtered to only active ones.

methods.name: getJobTitlesForEmployee
methods.description: Fetches job titles associated with a specific employee, including inactive if linked.

methods.name: getJobTitles
methods.description: Retrieves paginated and filtered list of job titles based on search parameters.

methods.name: getJobTitlesPaginator
methods.description: Internal method that builds a paginator object for job titles based on search filters.

methods.name: getJobTitlesCount
methods.description: Counts the number of job titles matching specific filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Marks specified job titles as deleted.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Fetches a job title by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingJobTitleIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing job titles from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a job specification attachment by its ID.

methods.name: saveJobTitle
methods.description: Persists a JobTitle entity to the database.

methods.name: getJobSpecificationByJobTitleId
methods.description: Fetches a partial job specification attachment associated with a particular job title ID.
